  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The bait commit can race with downstream reviewer/editor fetch timing.
  WHY: All three reviewers flagged a timing window here, and moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 rated it high confidence.

  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The cancellation assertion may run before GitHub Actions has propagated the PR-close event.
  WHY: All three reviewers identified asynchronous cancellation timing as a flake source.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:reviewer fidelity section | severity=medium | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]

  WHY: Two reviewers flagged possible timeout risk, while moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 considered the existing timeout sufficient.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:orchestrate-decompose-test cleanup phase | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Child-issue cleanup can race with the orchestrator poll cycle.
  WHY: All three reviewers flagged cleanup-vs-poll timing as a possible source of 404s or leftover state.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:validate-standalone-test job | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The standalone validation test can be skipped by doc-only or small-change gating.
  WHY: All three reviewers flagged the deterministic skip path, and moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 rated it high confidence.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (new jobs section) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `workflow_dispatch` on `internal-memory-maintenance.yml` may not forward `allow_workflow_edits`.
  WHY: The added dispatch path could omit the input and cause the workflow to use the wrong default or fail.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py (new file) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The 60K-character log cap may be too large for reliable analysis.
  WHY: Very large aggregated logs can be truncated or exceed practical model context limits, hiding the relevant failure pattern.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (Phase 3c/4b) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The bait commit may race with reviewer/editor pipeline fetch timing.
  WHY: The test relies on the pushed bait being visible before later verification steps, which may not be guaranteed.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (Phase 7) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cancel-on-PR-close assertion may run before the cancellation event propagates.
  WHY: GitHub Actions cancellation is asynchronous, so the check can be flaky if it runs too early.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (reviewer fidelity section) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Expanding to 6 models may exceed the check-run wait window.
  WHY: More reviewer runs can lengthen completion time enough to trip the smoke test timeout.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (orchestrate-decompose-test job) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Child-issue cleanup can race with the orchestrator poll cycle.
  WHY: Cleanup may happen while the orchestrator is still polling, causing 404s or leftover state.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (validate-standalone-test) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The standalone validation test can be skipped by doc-only or small-change gating.
  WHY: If the generated content is too small or documentation-only, the validation workflow may never run and the assertion will fail.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The standalone validation test can be skipped by the deterministic review-autofix gates.
  WHY: Doc-only or small-change conditions can bypass `internal-validate.yml`, leaving the test with empty or null validation results.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The bait commit can race with GitHub’s indexing of the push.
  WHY: Without a synchronization delay, later steps may query stale PR state and fail to observe the bait line removal.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The 60K character log cap can truncate critical failure patterns.
  WHY: Multiple workflow runs can produce enough output that the needed signal falls into the truncated portion of the aggregated logs.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Child-issue cleanup can race with the orchestrator poll cycle.
  WHY: The orchestrator may process the children between creation and cleanup, leaving orphaned state or causing cleanup errors.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The PR-close cancellation check can run before cancellation has propagated.
  WHY: GitHub Actions cancellation is asynchronous, so the assertion can flake if it executes too soon.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (validate-standalone-test) | confidence=3
